notes.title: Inspired by Lemmings and Pikmin, puzzle-platformer GOD'S GIFT is out now
notes.notes:
Following a successful Kickstarter back in late 2018, developer Straitjacket has launched GOD'S GIFT, a puzzle-platformer inspired by classic Lemmings and Pikmin.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/08/inspired-by-lemmings-and-pikmin-puzzle-platformer-gods-gift-is-out-now
